title: Necromancer's Forest Ritual
description: A blue-skinned necromancer in ornate green armor and helmet kneels in a snowy forest clearing, casting a spell from a glowing purple book with swirling magical energy. A large blue and pink monstrous creature with tentacle hair and a giant pink flower on its back floats above, while two zombie-like figures stand in the background and another defeated pink creature lies on the ground.
prompt: A blue-skinned necromancer wearing ornate green and black armor with a helmet kneels in a snowy forest at night, holding an open glowing purple spellbook with intricate designs that emits swirling purple magic and sparks. Above him floats a large bizarre blue creature with long black tentacle hair, green scaly torso, and a massive pink flower-like structure on its back, dripping colorful liquid. In the background stand two zombie-like figures in tattered robes and bandages near twisted dark trees with colorful dripping substance. Another defeated pink and blue creature lies on the snowy ground. The night sky features a swirling galaxy, stars, and colorful dripping paint effects from the top of the frame.
